## Record Meter Reading

The single writer of `Meter.readings`. A cumulative meter (odometer, runtime hours, cycle counter) can only go up — a lower reading is refused rather than silently accepted, since meter-based Maintenance Trigger math assumes monotonic values. A gauge meter (temperature, pressure) has no such constraint.

When `isPrimary` (the default), also stamps the owning Asset's `primaryMeterValue`/`primaryMeterUnit` so fitted tiles can show the reading without resolving the Meter link.
